name: merge
note: Generation-dominant stage; each agent ran >=3 grounding WebSearches so no concept was merged from misremembered detail. Heavy verification deferred to Stage 3.

merges.direction_name: Fibered Commitment Monads: a Grothendieck theory of staged irreversible decisions
merges.shared_mechanism: Monotone-indexed fiber unlocking: a base index (R-loop length / best-draft reward) advances and unlocks a larger fiber of admissible actions; Grothendieck construction + Beck monadicity formalize the gated 'commit' functor.

merges.direction_name: Dinatural Fission: coend self-consistency as a universal cooperativity detector
merges.shared_mechanism: An object appears both contravariantly (constraint) and covariantly (target); the coend diagonal marks the self-consistent commit point that collapses a parallel ensemble into one irreversible topological event (token accept / membrane sever).

merges.direction_name: Nesting-Threshold Replay Selection: a collective-externality model of memory consolidation
merges.shared_mechanism: Externality-gated collective amplification at a critical threshold: Fermi-surface nesting amplifies one wavevector; VCG selects the agent whose surplus exceeds its externality; SWR selects the supercritical replay sequence and suppresses competitors.

merges.direction_name: Chirality-Monotonicity Plasticity: Nash-implementable synaptic learning rules
merges.shared_mechanism: Broken symmetry creates a directional gate making transitions path-dependent: Rashba (spatial inversion), STDP (time reversal), Maskin monotonicity (preference-order); only direction-aligned perturbations stably propagate.

merges.direction_name: Fermi-Shell Positional Encoding: hyperspherical wavevector focusing for long context
merges.shared_mechanism: Spectral focusing on a privileged reciprocal/feature shell: Fermi nesting peak at 2k_F, hexagonal grid-cell reciprocal lattice, and QUEST per-query concentration on the key hypersphere all amplify response at special wavevectors.

merges.direction_name: Fractionalized Policy Optimization: two-velocity decoupling of exploration and refinement
merges.shared_mechanism: Two-mode velocity fractionalization: spinon/holon at v_s != v_c, ~20x SWR replay compression, and iGRPO slow-exploration vs fast-refinement; capacity is gained because the content and position modes are not locked together.

merges.direction_name: Algebraic Gatekeeping Protocols for verifiable biomolecular decision systems
merges.shared_mechanism: Multi-condition sequential lifting for irreversible commitment: split-coequalizer lifting (Beck) <-> conformational checkpoint scaffolding (Cas9) <-> externality-price gating (VCG); each stage scaffolds the next before the irreversible action is licensed.

merges.direction_name: Fibered Mechanism Incompleteness in staged biochemical degradation cascades
merges.shared_mechanism: Indexed-type resource impossibility under hidden fiber data: Myerson-Satterthwaite as non-existence of a budget-balanced global section of a type-fibration; the E1-E2-E3 ubiquitin cascade as the biological analogue with irrecoverable ATP 'deficit holonomy'.
